You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",

 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

Enrollment is complete and follow-up is ongoing. No phase 3 on-treatment Lp(a) reduction data are available; the calculator used the phase 2 week-36 nadir of -97.4% (75 mg Q12W) to estimate an expected hazard ratio of 0.772 (causal RRR 22.8%), requiring 470 events for 80% power. If the time-averaged effect over 5 years is ~50%, the expected HR would be ~0.88-0.90, requiring ~2,500+ events. Human genetics strongly support Lp(a) causality (Open Targets LPA score 0.922; Mendelian randomization ORs 1.38-3.67). The phase 3 dose is not confirmed in verified facts.
